izzyondroid:com.richardluo.globalIconPac.name: Global Icon Pack
izzyondroid:com.richardluo.globalIconPac.summary: An Xposed module for applying icon packs globally
izzyondroid:com.richardluo.globalIconPac.description:
Global Icon Pack
 An Xposed module for applying icon packs globally
 Some launchers support icon packs, however the icons are usually inconsistent across the whole system. For example, the Settings page and the Recent Apps screen may retain the default icons. This module is designed to extend the icon packs throughout the entire system.
 Requirements
 LSPosed
 Android 8.1+ (I tested on Android 14, 15. @Mickmick21 tested on Android 10, 12L.)
 Some features require AOSP-like OS
 Installation
 Install the apk.
 Select apps in lsposed. It should work for most apps/launchers , depending on the api they use.
 Open Global Icon Pack, choose an icon pack.
 Open the three dot menu, click each of Restart xxx .
 Notes
 Modes
 Use share mode whenever possible. The provider mode serves as a fallback if share mode doesn't work. Local mode is only reserved for testing and you can't use icon variants with this mode (However it maybe faster if there are only a few icon records).
 If you are using share mode, after uninstallation, you must remove /data/misc/com.richardluo.globalIconPack/iconPack.db manually.
 Sometimes system update may reset the permissions of share mode database. It is recommended that you deselect apps in LSPosed, after the update, select them again, and open GIP at least once (to setup the permissions), then click each of Restart xxx .
 Tips
 You can long press icon in icon chooser bottom sheet to try as calendar icon.
 In icon variant, the option Modified indicates that you have made changes to the icon variants. If enabled, when the icon pack updates, it will only add new icons instead of replacing all icons. Note that this could cause issues if any icon entry is missing in the new version!
 Launcher 3
 If you are using a different launcher3 based launcher, please input its package name into the launcher package name in pixel settings. If it is not launcher3 based, some functions may not work.
 Recent screen will use your default launcher unless you use quickswitch, so you will need to select pixel launcher for that to work.
 Pixel launcher saves its icon database in /data/data/com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher/databases/app_icons.db .
 For icon pack developers
 You can create a shortcut record by appending @ to the end of package name, and shortcut id as classname.
 Known Issues
 If the launcher is slow to boot or crashes, switch to 'local' mode.
 If it says "Please ensure the Xposed module has been enabled first" and you have the module enabled already, try force stopping then restart the app.
 Regardless of the minimum SDK version, you must test compatibility with android versions below 14 by yourself.
 Main Translators
 The list may not be latest. - Chinese Simplified - RichardLuo - German - elisenlebkuch - Max - Russian - Кирилл Гук - Artem Dreznel - Chinese Traditional - Jia-Bin - Turkish - Holi - French - MickMick21 - Jules - Portuguese - Cauã
 Disclaimer
 [!WARNING] * Please note that this module may not be fully compatible with all custom ROMs. * I do not take any responsibility for any damage or issues that may occur to your device.

TRACK YOUR USE
- Log every session: amount in grams, cost per gram, date and time
- Record the consumption method: smoked, vaporized, edible or other
- See the time since your last use, down to the second
- Track how much you spend on weed, today, this week and overall
- Add a use in one tap from the home screen widget
UNDERSTAND YOUR PATTERNS
- Statistics and graphs of your cannabis usage over time
- Usage by hour of day and by day of week, so you can see when the urge really hits
- Filter your history and spot the trends you would never notice from memory
- Watch the real cost of the habit add up
CUT DOWN AT YOUR OWN PACE
- Time-gate your sessions: set a minimum interval between uses and let the timer hold you to it
- Register pause periods for a tolerance break or a full stop
- No streak shaming, no pressure: the app shows you the data, you set the pace
WITHDRAWAL AND DRUG TESTS

- Estimates of when urine, blood, saliva and hair tests may come back clean, with the sources cited
PRIVACY BY DESIGN

HARM REDUCTION

WakeUpScreen is an open-source Android app that gently wakes your display the moment a notification arrives. No cloud, no clutter, no compromise.

• Instant Wake — Your screen lights up the moment a notification arrives. Never miss what matters while your phone sits on the desk.
• Pocket Mode — Intelligently detects when your phone is in a pocket or bag, and stays off. Saves battery where it counts.
• App Filtering — Choose exactly which apps can wake your screen. Full control over what deserves your attention.
• Dark Mode — A beautiful dark interface that feels at home on any AMOLED display. Easy on the eyes, easy on the battery.
• No Internet — Runs entirely on your device. Zero data collected, zero servers contacted. Your privacy is absolute.
• Lightweight — Minimal footprint, negligible battery impact. Built in Kotlin for native performance that just works.
How It Works:
1. Install and grant notification access. Only this single permission is required — your data never leaves your device.
2. Choose which apps can wake your screen. Let important messages through, filter the noise.
3. Live your life. WakeUpScreen runs silently in the background, lighting up on notification and staying dark in your pocket.
Additional features (all toggleable):
• Custom wake duration
• Do Not Disturb awareness — pauses wake-up while DND is enabled
• Sleep mode with custom quiet hours
• Persistent notification filtering — skips long-running notifications like music and navigation
• Charging-only filter — only wake when the device is charging
• Notification log with channel info (importance, sound, vibration)
• Function test page for diagnosing notification events
Built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3. Licensed under GPLv3. No ads, no tracking, no network permission.

fdroid:info.zamojski.soft.towercollector.description:
Tower Collector gives you opportunity to contribute in OpenCellID.org, BeaconDB and @t0stbrot projects by uploading GPS locations of GSM/UMTS/LTE/CDMA/TD-SCDMA/5G (NR) cell towers from your area. WGControl automatically manages your WireGuard tunnel based on your Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connections. It disables the tunnel when connected to your configured home Wi-Fi or selected Bluetooth devices (e.g., Android Auto) and re-enables it upon leaving.
This app is a VibeCode product. I have thoroughly tested all functions and believe everything works reliably. 
However, I assume no responsibility for errors, results of errors, or atomic fallout.
Key Features:
- Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Detection: Automatically toggles the tunnel based on home networks or paired Bluetooth devices.
- Real-Time Monitoring: Continuously checks system-level VPN status and enforces the target state.
- Ping Connectivity Check (optional, off by default): Verifies internet availability via ICMP/TCP ping to a configurable host (example.com by default) before re-enabling the tunnel.
- Notification Pause Buttons: Manually override the tunnel from the status notification - indefinitely or for a configurable duration - without opening the app.
- Admin Password Protection: Secures configuration tabs using salted PBKDF2 hashing.
- Local Logging: Tracks tunnel commands and network events locally for up to 24 hours with search and export capabilities.
- QuickSettings Tiles and widget to control pause.
Essential Setup Steps:
1. WireGuard App: Enable "Allow user-controlled tunnel management" in settings.
2. Grant Permission: Allow "WireGuard tunnel control" permission.
3. Location Access: Set to "Allow all the time" for background Wi-Fi detection.
4. Battery Optimization: Disable for BOTH WGControl and the WireGuard app.
Note: Not affiliated with WireGuard or Jason A. Donenfeld. Controls the official WireGuard app via its public broadcast interface.

• iPhone & iPad Photos library (works with iCloud Photos)
• iCloud Drive
• OneDrive
• Google Photos: scan a Takeout export
• Amazon Photos: scan your downloaded library
FIND EVERY DUPLICATE
• Exact matching by checksum: byte-identical copies within and across sources
• Visually similar matching: re-encoded, edited or resized copies, matched entirely on your device
• One shared index: scan each source once and CloudSweep finds duplicates inside every source AND across them
CLEAN UP SAFELY
• Every removal goes to a recoverable trash (about 30 days), never permanent
• At least one copy of a file always survives
• Copies are re-verified before deleting, so a file that changed since your scan is never touched
• Imported libraries (Google Photos Takeout, Amazon Photos) are copies of your originals, so CloudSweep guides you to the original and verifies your cleanup instead of pretending
• Favorites and photos in Shared Albums are protected by default: CloudSweep leaves them out of every cleanup
• Mark photos as junk while you review, see the whole set together, then clear it in one pass
• Recently removed lists what each cleanup took, with the way to get every file back
MOVE BETWEEN CLOUDS
• Bring photos and videos from OneDrive, a Google Photos export or an Amazon Photos folder into your Photos library, or back up your Photos library to your iCloud Drive folder
• Every copy is written at original quality, read back and compared byte for byte before it counts
• Nothing leaves the source until you confirm the cleanup afterwards, and originals then go to a recoverable trash
MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• On iPad, iPhone Duo and a wide Mac window, the list of duplicate groups sits beside the group you are reviewing
• Fold or unfold iPhone Duo mid-task and you keep your place and your selection
• Layouts adapt to the largest text sizes
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• All duplicate matching runs on your device
• No accounts on our side, no analytics, no tracking
• Sign-in tokens live only in your device Keychain
• Your files never touch our servers
FREE & PREMIUM

DP has tab-specific support and domain whitelisting/blacklisting!
Supports Arabic, German, English (US and British), Spanish, Tagalog, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazilian and Portugal), Russian, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)!
Please note that I am not responsible for what you do with this extension and any subsequent consequences; please browse responsibly.

-replace page titles
-keyboard toggle (CTRL + 12)
-choose between tab-specific cloaking or global cloaking
-choose whether new tabs are cloaked or uncloaked by default

-add right-click option to open links/images safely (can be removed in Options)
-choose between four modes: Paranoid (remove images and multimedia), SFW0 (cloak images and multimedia), SFW1 (cloak images and remove multimedia), SFW2 (cloak images only), and NSFW (show all)
-add toggle icon in address bar (can be removed in Options)
-choose from 98 different icons for added discreetness
-set a custom title for the address bar icon

-quickly whitelist/blacklist the current tab's domain by right-clicking on the toolbar icon

firefox-addons:2884779.summary: Download photos, product data and conversations from Vinted.
firefox-addons:2884779.description:
Use the Vinted Photo and Data Downloader add-on to download from Vinted:
on product pages:
 complete product data (in JSON format), including id, title, description, price, seller information, dates, photos urls, etc.
 summary (in text format), including url, title, description, seller username and id,
 photos in full resolution;
on conversation pages:
 complete conversation (in JSON format),
 complete shipping and tracking data (in JSON format),

NOTE: Vinted added a challenge to download conversation data. In order to bypass this challenge, the extension now requires more permissions. If this is an issue for you, you can contact me and I will separate downloading products vs conversations in 2 different apps (one requiring almost no permission, and one needing more permissions).

Once installed, navigate to a Vinted product or conversation. The Vinted Photo and Data Downloader icon appear in the address bar: click on it to reveal the download buttons.
The code source is available on Github .
 Vinted is an European online marketplace for buying and selling second hand items. You can access it at vinted.fr , vinted.it , vinted.be , etc. I am not affiliated with Vinted in any way .

firefox-addons:2684730.name: Password-Toggle
firefox-addons:2684730.summary: Hides/shows content of password fields by pressing the Shift key three times.
firefox-addons:2684730.description:
Password-Toggle is a tiny Firefox extension that allows you to make the contents of password fields visible by pressing the Shift key three times, so you can check your input.
 The extension also handles dynamically added input fields; so it should work on all websites.
 The extension doesn't add elements to websites , so it can't interfere with the layout.
 Important: this extension relies on keydown and keyup events, so it may not work with touchscreen devices .
 Security : "Access your data for various websites" sounds dangerous, but the extension uses this permission only to search for password input fields and equip them with the show/hide feature. The password text itself is never touched .

firefox-addons:2621482.name: MindYourPass Password Firewall
firefox-addons:2621482.summary: MindYourPass Password Firewall is an application that offers organizations insight and control over online acounts.
firefox-addons:2621482.description:
The MindYourPass password firewall gives insight into the password quality of your online accounts.
In the free mode, it gives you a real-time quality monitor of the passwords that you're using. This is to increase your awareness of your online security. After installation, the extension silently starts monitoring the quality of the passwords that you’re using to sign into your online accounts. If you click on the extension button, a popup window shows the average quality of your passwords as well as some additional information. The monitoring is performed on your device. No data is shared with MindYourPass.
In combination with a MindYourPass license, the extension improves the cybersecurity of you and your organization. It then integrates with the MindYourPass on-the-fly password generator to help you to protect your accounts with the strongest-passwords possible. This not only improves your own online cyber security, but also that of your organization. Depending on your organization's configuration of the firewall, it can reject your password if it isn't strong enough, or just record this.
Passwords that are always accepted are those that are generated by the MindYourPass on-the-fly password generator ( https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/mindyourpass/ ). This generator, which is free for personal use, uses a patented technology for generating the strongest possible passwords for you without ever storing them. To generate such strong passwords, you only need a single, easy-to-remember password. You can reuse this easy-to-remember password for all your accounts.
Please note that:
 MindYourPass does not have your identity. Therefore you stay anonymous. 
 MindYourPass does not store or transmit your passwords. Therefore, with MindYourPass, your passwords are always safe and private.

ReceGuard is a private receipt scanner, expense tracker, and purchase vault for iPhone.
Scan paper receipts, organize important purchases, and keep the details you need when it is time to return an item, claim a warranty, prepare expenses, or find proof of purchase.
Just scan a receipt with your camera and ReceGuard helps capture the important details: merchant, date, total, currency, and receipt text. Save everything in one searchable place instead of digging through drawers, emails, screenshots, or faded paper receipts.
WHY RECEGUARD
• Scan receipts in seconds
Use your iPhone camera to capture receipts and purchase documents quickly.
• Automatic text recognition
On-device OCR helps extract useful receipt details like merchant, date, amount, and currency.
• Search everything
Find receipts by merchant, total, date, category, notes, or scanned text.
• Track purchases, warranties, and returns
Save the items that matter and keep warranty or return information close when you need it.
• Organize personal and business expenses
Keep receipts grouped, searchable, and ready for expense tracking or record keeping.
• Export when needed
Create clean exports for your records, accountant, reimbursement, or tax preparation.
• Private by design
Receipt scanning and text recognition happen on your device. ReceGuard does not need a custom backend to store your purchase history.
• Optional iCloud sync
Keep your receipts available across your Apple devices using your own iCloud account.
BUILT FOR
• Personal receipt organization
• Expense tracking
• Freelancers and small business owners
• Warranty and return tracking
• Tax-time record keeping
• Travel receipts
• Home purchases and important documents
Stop losing receipts. Scan them once, search them anytime, and keep your purchases organized with ReceGuard.
Pro purchases

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://receguard.com/privacy

Prices are shown in the app in your App Store currency. Buying Lifetime Pro does not automatically cancel an existing subscription; manage existing subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

专为处理跨国业务的企业客户而设计。我们整合了高质量的国际业务专线节点，并采用先进的智能路由技术，致力于为您的跨国业务提供稳定、高效、安全可靠的网络连接。显著降低业务数据延迟，提升协同办公效率，保障数据安全传输。
【核心功能】
国际业务专线
在全球主要商业区域部署了多个高性能服务器，覆盖亚太、北美、欧洲等地区。
提供多种高品质企业级专线，无论是进行跨国视频会议、管理海外电商平台，还是进行国际市场推广直播，都能保障业务的稳定与高效。
实时业务监控
精准显示业务网络的实时延迟（Ping值）、连接IP、服务器位置等关键信息。
让您对当前的业务网络状态了如指掌，一切尽在掌握。
企业级数据统计
提供详尽的流量使用报告，清晰区分业务加速与本地直连流量。
您可以随时查看连接时长和数据消耗，企业成本管理透明，心中有数。
高效易用的设计
界面专业，操作直观，专注于核心的业务加速功能。
我们相信，强大的功能也应拥有高效易用的体验，一键启用，专注业务。
【我们的服务对象】
本服务专为以下企业和专业人士提供支持：
跨境电商企业： 需要稳定管理海外平台店铺、处理订单的运营团队。
国际直播业务： 面向海外市场进行产品推广、品牌宣传的直播团队。
出海企业与开发者： 需要与海外团队进行远程协同办公、访问国际技术资源的专业人士。
国际贸易公司： 需要高效沟通、安全传输业务数据的外贸从业者。
